Post Text:
Supplier Agent Request ? Dropshipping Shower Filters
Hello,

I am looking for a reliable and experienced supplier agent for my dropshipping store. My main product is a shower filter, and I am looking for a long-term supplier who can support my business as order volume grows.

My target markets are Germany and Switzerland, and I am looking for a supplier who can offer good product quality, fast shipping, reliable tracking and smooth Shopify integration.

Product Requirements

* Product: Shower filters

* Good and consistent quality

* Reliable and professional packaging

* Product should be suitable for the European market

* Competitive product price

* Possibility to order individual customer orders directly from my Shopify store

Shipping Requirements

My target delivery time is:

* Germany: 7?14 days

* Switzerland: 7?14 days

Please provide your available shipping lines and the exact estimated delivery times for each option.

I also require:

* Full tracking number for every order

* Tracking information that works reliably in Germany and Switzerland

* Tracking number sent to Shopify automatically if possible

* Reliable shipping line with low loss/delay rates

* Individual dropshipping orders without requiring bulk shipments

Target Cost

My target is approximately ?10?15 total per order, including:

Product price + shipping cost

Please send me your best price for the shower filter and the shipping cost separately so I can calculate the total cost.

EU Packaging Requirements ? Important

As I will be selling to customers in the European Union, the packaging must be suitable for the EU market and applicable packaging requirements.

The EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) generally starts applying from 12 August 2026. It aims, among other things, to reduce unnecessary packaging, improve recyclability and reduce packaging waste. (Environment)

Therefore, I need the supplier to confirm that the product packaging can comply with the applicable EU packaging requirements.

Please provide information about:

* Type and material of the product packaging

* Type and material of the shipping packaging

* Whether the packaging is recyclable

* Whether unnecessary packaging can be avoided

* Packaging dimensions and weight

* Whether you can provide packaging/material information or relevant compliance documentation

* Whether you can adapt the packaging if required for EU compliance

* Whether you can use smaller and efficient packaging to avoid unnecessary empty space

I want to make sure that the packaging is appropriate for selling products to customers in Germany and other EU countries.

Shopify Integration

Shopify integration is very important to me.

Ideally, I need:

* Automatic order synchronization

* Orders automatically forwarded to the supplier

* Automatic fulfillment

* Automatic tracking-number synchronization

* Tracking information automatically updated in Shopify

* API, app or other Shopify integration if available

Please explain exactly how your Shopify integration works.

Please Send Me This Information

1. Company name

2. Official company website

3. Warehouse location

4. Supplier/agent contact information

5. Shower filter product price

6. Shipping price to Germany

7. Shipping price to Switzerland

8. Available shipping lines

9. Estimated shipping time to Germany

10. Estimated shipping time to Switzerland

11. Tracking availability

12. Shopify integration options

13. Minimum order quantity, if any

14. Dropshipping experience

15. Product sample price

16. Private labeling/custom packaging options

17. Packaging materials and dimensions

18. EU packaging compliance information/documentation

19. Processing time per order

20. Whether you can handle individual daily orders

21. Whether you offer better prices for higher order volumes

Long-Term Partnership

I am not looking for a one-time supplier. I am looking for a reliable long-term supplier agent.

If the product quality, shipping times, packaging, prices and service are good, I am interested in building a long-term partnership and increasing the order volume over time.

Please send me your best offer including product price, shipping costs, shipping lines, delivery times, Shopify integration, packaging information, EU compliance information and your official company website.

Thank you. I look forward to your reply and hopefully building a long-term business relationship.

Best regards
